MRO-Bench Dataset
	

MRO-Bench is a specialized benchmark designed to evaluate next-generation LLMs (equipped with tool-calling, RAG, and complex reasoning) in the domain of Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) procurement.

	
		
		1. Architectural Vision
	

In Industrial MRO scenarios, queries are often unstructured and contain high-density engineering parameters. reputation: Niche, industry-focused benchmark with growing interest among enterprise and industrial ML teams working on procurement and maintenance LLMs.
